---
title: "Mixed-Language Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

Use this notebook to exercise the R-first workflow while calling Python through `reticulate`.

```{r setup}
# Declare the notebook location so here() can resolve project-relative paths.
here::i_am("notebooks/01_mixed_language_notebook.Rmd")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir=here::here())

# Load the shared project setup used across scripts and notebooks.
source(here::here("setup", "R", "setup_reticulate.R"))

# Use the shared conda environment before any Python imports happen.
setup_reticulate()
```

## Call Python from R via reticulate

```{r}
# Import the Python helper module and summarize a small numeric vector.
reticulate::source_python(here::here("python", "helpers.py"))
values <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
py_summary <- summarize_values(values)
py_summary
```

## Bring the result back into R

```{r}
# Convert the Python dictionary into a simple R data frame.
summary_df <- data.frame(metric=names(py_summary), value=unlist(py_summary), row.names=NULL)

summary_df
```

## Native R work

```{r}
# Mix in a regular R calculation after the Python-backed step.
mean(values)
```
